title: Ariana Grande Leads a Starry Christmas Carol on The Tonight Show
summary:
It is beginning to sound a lot like Christmas on late-night TV. Pop star Ariana Grande teamed up with her movie co-stars Robert De Niro and Ben Stiller for a surprise Christmas carol on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon on Sunday night.

The trio sang the traditional tune 'O Christmas Tree' to ring in the holiday season. Grande took the lead on vocals, of course, and the audience could not help applauding when she hit those high notes. Stiller gave a valiant effort on his part of the song. As for De Niro, well, you will have to watch the clip to see how his turn plays out.

The performance was part of the show's celebration of the arrival of the 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas tree this weekend. The episode aired at 11:35 p.m. ET, right after the Buccaneers vs. Bears football game on NBC, and also featured rapper Lil Baby as the musical guest.

The stars were on the show to promote their new movie, Focker-in-Law, which opens in theatres on November 25. It is the latest film in the popular Meet the Parents series. Grande plays Olivia Jones, who is dating Henry, the now grown-up son of Greg and Pam Focker, played by Stiller and Teri Polo. Skyler Gisondo plays Henry.

The three stars chatted with Fallon throughout the episode. It was the second of four special Tonight Show episodes airing after NBC's Sunday Night Football broadcasts this season. The first aired on September 27, with Sylvester Stallone and Luke Bryan as guests. The next one, on November 15, will feature Jennifer Lopez and Anthony Mackie, plus a musical performance from Quavo. One more is planned for January 10, with guests still to be announced.
why_it_matters: Christmas carols and holiday traditions bring people together, and this story shows how stars from different generations can share a fun moment on live TV.
